`exposure.json.gz` is the one file left here: a saved opening journey captured from main commit `93cf190d93a714e574ed09844dc42b40e190a08c`, rules 103, Greek revision 20, gzip-compressed JSON from the old `openingFixture("exposure")`. It is the frozen input that `card-legacy-journey-boundary.test.mjs` replays under the released rules 110 engine, so it must stay byte-for-byte as it is. No current rules load it.

The other recorded openings (burial, concession, late-report, dry) went with the Theban-response branch in rules 133 and are deleted. The errands before the funeral are played on the current rules by `greekErrands()` in `test/helpers/greek-opening.mjs` from `test/journeys/greek-before-funeral.mjs`, and the funeral itself by `funeralJourney()` in `test/helpers/greek-funeral.mjs`. The Open Door opens by burying Polynices; `openDoorStart()` in `test/helpers/open-door.mjs` is that burial walked home to Dione's courtyard.
